name: ponko
description: Inspect, debug, and profile local Ponko Engine games with MCP tools and guided workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect and profile local Ponko games
interface.longDescription: Connect to local Ponko Engine games to inspect entities and resources, debug simulations, capture frames, and measure performance. Requires the ponko-mcp executable and a local game with its control endpoint enabled.
defaultPrompt: Connect to my Ponko game and inspect its current state.
Profile my Ponko game and identify the slowest systems.
